{{Top|leg}}
The '''communications/sensor array''' was a state-of-the-art [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] unit that was installed on [[Hound-W2 SPD]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The array included [[Olfactory sensor/Legends|olfactory]], [[Chemical sensor|chemical]], [[Heat detector|thermal]], [[Radionic Sensor|radionic]], and [[Electromagnetic sensor|electromagnetic]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
